strengths: Correctly identifies T cell lineage from ORIGINAL markers CD3D, CD2, IL7R, LTB, CD52, IL32
Correctly excludes B/NK/myeloid alternatives by absence of CD79A/MS4A1, NKG7/GNLY/PRF1, CD14/S100A8/9
Appropriately avoids over-specifying CD4+ without direct CD4 evidence
weaknesses: Topk contains unmixed/multi-label memory phenotypes that are not directly supported
Memory interpretation relies on indirect marker reasoning (S100A4 family, absence of CCR7/SELL) rather than definitive T-memory markers
S100/AQP3/AP-1 genes are shared with activated/non-T states and do not add subtype specificity

strengths: Parsimonious and evidence-faithful: T cell support from CD3D, CD2, IL7R, LTB, CD52, IL32
Consistent with absence of B/NK/myeloid lineage markers
weaknesses: Minimal interpretive depth; does not document memory/activation state
No explicit discussion of why naive/CD4-specific enrich label is not adopted

strengths: Recognizes the underlying T cell identity from CD3D, CD2, IL7R, LTB
Correctly rules out NK/cytotoxic T cell due to absence of FCGR3A, FGFBP2, KLRF1, granzymes/perforin
weaknesses: Adds 'naive' and 'CD4+' components without direct ORIGINAL positive support: CCR7, SELL, TCF7 and CD4/CD8A are absent from top DEGs
IL7R is expressed on both naive and memory T cells and cannot distinguish the two
Reported enrichment output is corrupted (negative p.adjust, non-informative pathway names), weakening enrichment-based subtype confidence

supporting: T-cell lineage supported by ORIGINAL cluster DEGs CD3D, CD2, IL7R, LTB, CD52, IL32
Absence of B-cell (CD79A/MS4A1), NK-cell (NKG7/GNLY/PRF1/KLRD1), and myeloid (CD14/S100A8/9/CST3/FCN1) markers restricts identity to T/lymphoid lineage
PMID 36658547 provides permitted literature context consistent with T cell identity
conflicting: clusterProfiler reviewer's 'naive CD4+ T cell' label conflicts with the ORIGINAL absence of naive markers CCR7, SELL, TCF7 and lineage markers CD4/CD8A from top DEGs
Enrichment output contains corrupted p.adjust values and generic pathway descriptions, making subtype claims unreliable
enrichment_or_literature: Observed enrichment in Cytokine Signaling in Immune system, Signaling by Interleukins, and immune system pathways is consistent with T cell identity but does not support naive/CD4 specificity
PMID 36658547 is the permitted citation used for T cell identity support
